SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF JUN-26-2018 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF JUN-26-2018 BY PRO TEM DAVID LAVINE. 506 PLAINTIFF MIRANDA MATTHEWS IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT GETAROUND IS PRESENT, REPRESENTED BY KENNETH LAU, SAFETY MANAGER. NO PROOF OF SERVICE. DEFENDANT WAIVES RIGHT TO SERVICE. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: DAVID LAVINE; CLERK: G. FELICIANO; NOT REPORTED. 506
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JUN-26-2018 - JUDGMENT.

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF MATTHEWS, MIRANDA RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT GETAROUND $6,000.00 PRINCIPAL, $75.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $6,075.00, THE COURT FINDS THAT DEFENDANT WAS NEGLIGENT IN DIRECTING THE PLAINTIFF TO LEAVE A KEY IN THE VISOR AND NOT IN A LOCKBOX OR OTHER MORE PROTECTED PLACE. EVEN APART FROM THE MOBILIZATION FEATURE AND THE LACK OF INCLUDED INSURANCE WHILE SHARED CAR WAS PARKED. DEFENDANT NEGLIGENCE CONTRIBUTED TO THE THEFT OF THE CAR. DAMAGES ARE ALLOWED AS PLAINTIFF ITEMIZED, BUT NOT FULL ON VALUE BASED ON THE CARFAX ESTIMATE. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
